title: Assess Easter Sales Collapse and Response
instructions: Analyze the provided store, chain, category, discount, profit, and calendar data. Quantify the sales collapse, rank the evidence-supported drivers, rule out weaker explanations, assess whether a price promotion is justified, and recommend a measurable operational response. Output: easter_sales_incident_memo.md
criteria: Identifies transaction loss as the primary driver and basket increase as contradictory to a basket explanation.
Does not equate an Easter traffic shock with a full closure or data loss.
